subject: MSE
title: Introduction to Materials Science
description: Fundamental principles of structure, processing, and properties of materials. Topics include crystal structures, imperfections, diffusion, and phase diagrams.

subject: MSE
title: Thermodynamics of Materials
description: Application of thermodynamic principles to materials. Includes free energy, entropy, enthalpy, and equilibria in materials systems.

subject: MSE
title: Mechanical Behaviour of Materials
description: Elastic and plastic deformation, strengthening mechanisms, creep, fatigue, and fracture of materials.

subject: MSE
title: Phase Transformations
description: Principles and kinetics of phase transformations in metallic and ceramic systems. Includes diffusion, nucleation, growth, and microstructural evolution.

subject: MSE
title: Electronic Properties of Materials
description: Electrical conductivity, semiconductors, magnetic properties, dielectric properties, and superconductivity of materials.

subject: MSE
title: Materials Processing
description: Processing of metals, ceramics, and polymers, including solidification, powder processing, welding, and forming techniques.

subject: MSE
title: Corrosion and Degradation of Materials
description: Electrochemical principles, forms of corrosion, high-temperature oxidation, and prevention methods.

subject: MSE
title: Composite Materials
description: Constituents, microstructure, mechanical behaviour, and applications of composite materials.

subject: MSE
title: Materials Selection and Design
description: Systematic selection of materials for engineering design. Use of Ashby charts and performance indices.

subject: MSE
title: Advanced Materials Characterization
description: Principles and applications of modern materials characterization techniques including X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, and spectroscopy.

subject: MSE
title: Advanced Materials Thermodynamics
description: Advanced topics in thermodynamics applied to multicomponent and multiphase materials systems.

subject: MSE
title: Advanced Mechanical Behaviour of Materials
description: Fracture mechanics, fatigue, creep, and failure analysis of advanced engineering materials.

subject: MSE
title: Nanomaterials
description: Synthesis, characterization, and applications of nanostructured materials.

subject: MSE
title: Special Topics in Materials Engineering 1
description: Selected advanced topics in materials science and engineering.

subject: MSE
title: Special Topics in Materials Engineering 2
description: Continuation of selected advanced topics in materials science and engineering.
